# 1. Promote Meritocratic "New Men" to counter the strongest noble house (Alexios Apokaukos precedent).
oe_bp2_dec_promote_new_men = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		oe_bp2_pillars_live = yes
	}
	allow = {
		is_subject = no
		oe_bp2_any_active_house = yes
		oe_bp2_authority_now >= 10
		gold >= 120
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_bp2_new_men_cd }
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:nobles } }
	option = {
		name = oe_bp2_dec_promote_new_men.a
		ai_chance = { value = 70 }
		effect = {
			add_gold = -120
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_new_men_cd years = 10 }
			custom_tooltip = oe_bp2_dec_promote_new_men.a.tt
			hidden_effect = {
				oe_bp2_add_auth = { amount = -10 }
				oe_bp2_add_opin = { amount = 4 }
				oe_bp2_change_strongest_house = { amount = -65 }
			}
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_bp2_new_man_cadre years = 10 mode = replace }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_bp2_dec_promote_new_men.b
		ai_chance = { value = 30 }
		effect = {
			add_gold = -80
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_new_men_cd years = 10 }
			custom_tooltip = oe_bp2_dec_promote_new_men.b.tt
			hidden_effect = {
				oe_bp2_add_auth = { amount = -5 }
				oe_bp2_change_strongest_house = { amount = -30 }
			}
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_bp2_chancellery_clerks years = 10 mode = replace }
		}
	}
}

# 4. Dual-track Romanization 2.0 Cultural Identity Choice (Hellenic Purism vs Pan-Mediterranean Citizenship).
oe_bp2_dec_roman_identity = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		oe_bp2_is_imperial_host = yes
		OR = {
			current_age_or_later = { age = age_2_renaissance }
			current_year >= 1420
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_bp2_identity_locked }
	}
	allow = {
		is_subject = no
		location:constantinople = { has_owner = yes owner = root }
		stability >= 5
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_bp2_identity_pivot_cd }
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_bp2_identity_track }
			current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism }
			current_year >= 1680
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 20 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:clergy background = pop_type:burghers } }
	option = {
		name = oe_bp2_dec_roman_identity.a
		ai_chance = { value = 45 }
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_bp2_identity_track }
				add_stability = -15
				set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_identity_locked value = 1 }
				hidden_effect = { oe_bp2_add_auth = { amount = -15 } }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_identity_track value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_id_hellenic value = 1 }
			remove_variable = oe_bp2_id_universal_rome
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_identity_pivot_cd years = 30 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_bp2_universal_citizenship
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_bp2_hellenic_purism years = -1 mode = replace }
			custom_tooltip = oe_bp2_dec_roman_identity.a.tt
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_bp2_dec_roman_identity.b
		ai_chance = { value = 55 }
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_bp2_identity_track }
				add_stability = -15
				set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_identity_locked value = 1 }
				hidden_effect = { oe_bp2_add_auth = { amount = -15 } }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_identity_track value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_id_universal_rome value = 1 }
			remove_variable = oe_bp2_id_hellenic
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_identity_pivot_cd years = 30 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_bp2_hellenic_purism
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_bp2_universal_citizenship years = -1 mode = replace }
			custom_tooltip = oe_bp2_dec_roman_identity.b.tt
		}
	}
}
